known_issues.summary: test.py fails: 'The syntax of the command is incorrect. ns3 died. Not running tests'
known_issues.suspected_cause: Project path contains spaces ('VIT Vellore Research one', 'Astra Adhocnetworks'). test.py re-invokes ./ns3 through a shell in a way that does not survive spaces on Windows. CMake, Ninja and './ns3 run' quote correctly and are unaffected.
known_issues.corroboration: The unrelated ICTC project's dependency_plan.md independently advises: 'Prefer a short, space-free toolchain/build path on D:', and that project used D:\ictc-toolchain.
known_issues.constraint: The execution directive requires all project files to remain inside ASTRA_PROJECT_ROOT, whose path contains spaces. Relocating is therefore not permitted; the direct-runner workaround is the correct resolution.
known_issues.status: WORKAROUND VERIFIED; root cause not yet confirmed by isolation test

known_issues.summary: './ns3 test' subcommand does not exist in ns-3.46.1
known_issues.detail: Valid subcommands are: help, build, configure, clean, distclean, install, uninstall, run, shell, docs, show.
known_issues.status: RESOLVED - use test.py or the test-runner binary
